pages.text: Under every meteor's floor runs a Warren: mineshaft-style tunnels with wooden supports and old rails, joining rooms on two levels. Store rooms hold chests and barrels, nest rooms hold spawners, and pillared halls hold whatever's living there.
pages.title: The Warrens

pages.text: $(thing)Getting in:$() look for the large wooden entrance huts with doors. A spiral stair inside goes down to the first level. Another spiral stair leads to the deep level and its $(thing)vault$(), which has the best loot and nests in its corners.$(br2)Small huts without stairs have a nest inside, and a chest.

Side tunnels end in a chest, a nest or a cave-in. The tunnels are dark, so the meteor's bugs spawn there on their own too. Bring light.$(br2)The Warrens are where the $(l:gear/materials)crafting drops$(/l) come from: the dungeon bugs spawn from the nests here.
